segments.title: Close on the handle
segments.code:
def close_at_pose(max_steps=18, minimum_steps=8, stable_steps=3, gap_tolerance=0.001):
    observation = get_observation()
    position = observation["state.end_effector_position_relative"].copy()
    quaternion = observation["state.end_effector_rotation_relative"].copy()
    previous_gap = np.sum(np.abs(observation["state.gripper_qpos"]))
    stable_count = 0
    for index in range(max_steps):
        position_error = position - observation["state.end_effector_position_relative"]
        rotation_error = quaternion_error(quaternion, observation["state.end_effector_rotation_relative"])
        observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info = step(robot_action(np.clip(position_error * 12.0, -0.25, 0.25), np.clip(rotation_error * 1.5, -0.3, 0.3), True))
        gap = np.sum(np.abs(observation["state.gripper_qpos"]))
        if info.get("success") or terminated or truncated:
            return {"status": "success" if info.get("success") else "terminated", "steps": index + 1, "gap": gap, "observation": observation}
        stable_count = stable_count + 1 if np.abs(gap - previous_gap) <= gap_tolerance else 0
        if index + 1 >= minimum_steps and stable_count >= stable_steps:
            return {"status": "settled", "steps": index + 1, "gap": gap, "observation": observation}
        previous_gap = gap
    return {"status": "budget", "steps": max_steps, "gap": previous_gap, "observation": observation}


def pull_handle(direction, distance, max_steps=60, action_limit=0.35, minimum_gripper_gap=0.008):
    direction = np.asarray(direction)
    magnitude = np.linalg.norm(direction)
    if magnitude < 0.000001 or distance <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Provide a nonzero base-frame pull direction and positive distance")
    observation = get_observation()
    position = observation["state.end_effector_position_relative"].copy()
    quaternion = observation["state.end_effector_rotation_relative"].copy()
    target = position + direction * (distance / magnitude)
    result = servo_pose(target, quaternion, gripper_closed=True, max_steps=max_steps, position_tolerance=0.012, action_limit=action_limit, minimum_gripper_gap=minimum_gripper_gap)
    result["start_position"] = position
    result["target_position"] = target
    return result
